protocol: Frozen before follow-up inference. Previous 14 cases are known development/regression evidence, not new holdouts. Eleven new reserved sources must not guide changes to prompts/configuration. Same five dimensions, strict all-2 acceptance. One stable configuration, explicit failed-item retries only; preserve all transport/application results. Open cases request short_answer explicitly rather than allowing mixed types. No model judge.
